title: Scoped SSO session exports and SCIM lifecycle reconciler for compliance evidence
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Implement a cross-tenant solution that (1) generates tamper-evident exports of SSO/SAML session events scoped by tenant and residency region, (2) runs a SCIM lifecycle reconciler that enforces account expiry/disabled state and emits reconciliation evidence, and (3) ties both pipelines into the automated evidence/reporting system with configured retention controls. This ticket covers design, schema changes, the reconciler worker, export signing, retention enforcement, and an initial rollout plan for low-risk tenants.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A per-tenant SSO session export job exists that can produce daily and ad-hoc exports filtered by tenant_id and region_tag, with export files cryptographically signed and uploadable to the evidence storage bucket.

A2: The SCIM reconciler runs incremental reconciliations per-tenant, detecting drift (missing users, stale service accounts, mismatched roles), applies configurable policy actions (disable, mark-expired, log-only), and writes a reconciliation report that includes diffs and rationale.

A3: Exports and reconciliation reports respect tenant retention settings (e.g., 90/365/indefinite) and are automatically purged or archived according to retention rules. Purge operations produce an audit record.

A4: Exports and reports are discoverable in the Console evidence UI and available via signed URLs for compliance reviewers; test workflow produces sample evidence for a regulated tenant in eu-west that meets audit criteria.
A5: Implementation includes metrics (success/failure counts, time per tenant, export size), monitoring alerts for failures, and a runbook for troubleshooting and data recovery.
A6: Security review completed and KMS key usage for export signing is validated in staging.
A7: Rollout plan defined with canary list, backout criteria (error rate, latency spike, reconciliation false-positive rate > 5%), and migration steps for existing ad-hoc exports.
A8: Unit and integration tests cover edge cases: partial SCIM failures, network blips during upload, tenant with strict residency (EU-only), and long-running reconciliations.
A9: Documentation links (design doc, operator runbook, Console spec) provided and reviewed by PM and Security.
A10: No customer-facing outage introduced; canary tenants remain on current exporter until validation passes.
progress_updates: 2025-11-05: Kickoff with PM (Radhika Singh) and Security (Evan Li). Identified two constraints: (1) eu-west tenants must never have exports leaving eu-west storage, (2) SCIM operations must be idempotent and rate-limited per-provider.

2025-11-12: Prototype export signer implemented (staging). Using project KMS key 'projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/compliance/cryptoKeys/evidence-sign' for HSM-backed signing. Spoke with Security; KMS access requires scoped service account.

2025-11-20: PoC SCIM reconciler worker completed for a single tenant. Reconciler reports include a delta bucket object with JSON lines and a SHA256 checksum. Not yet integrated with retention purge flow.
2025-11-28: Design review feedback from Design and PM: add Console evidence discovery filters (tenant, region, time-range, retention status). Also requested sample CSV export for auditors.

2025-12-01: Implemented per-tenant config: export_schedule, retention_days, residency_region, scim_policy (disable_after_days, dry_run). Config stored in tenant-config DB with encrypted columns for provider creds.
2025-12-04: Integration tests started. Found race where SCIM job and manual account disable API both change same user state; added optimistic locking and reconciliation idempotency token.
2025-12-07: Security review scheduled; created ticket for KMS access rotation and documented key usage in design doc.
2025-12-08: Canaries selected (tenant IDs: T-EU-042, T-NA-113). Next: enable daily export for canaries and run reconciler in 'dry_run' for two weeks.

Decisions: Use signed JSONL+manifest format for export (manifest includes file checksum, tenant_id, region_tag, date, signer_key_id). Use pubsub-triggered workers to parallelize by tenant shard. Retention enforcement will be executed by a single purger service per-region to avoid cross-region transfers.
comments: PM Radhika Singh: Please capture auditor-friendly delta summaries (human readable) in addition to machine JSON. We need a 1-page PDF export for legal review.
Security Evan Li: Confirmed KMS approach. Ensure signer key rotation plan and HSM audit logs are included in final runbook.
SRE Jonah Park: Add throttling at reconciler level for SCIM providers; maintain per-tenant token bucket counters to avoid provider lockouts.
Design Lea Morales: Console filter mocks uploaded to Drive -> /Designs/Compliance/EvidenceFilters_v2.pdf. Use these filters to validate the evidence discovery API contract.
Eng review (Arjun Patel): PR opened https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2147 implementing export signer and manifest writer. Needs unit tests for manifest validation.
notes: Migration note: existing ad-hoc export pipeline will be paused during tenant migration window. Migrator will create initial snapshot export and then flip to scheduled exporters after successful verification.
Operational note: retain manifest for 7 years for regulated tenants in APAC as per legal guidance. Retention rules configurable per-tenant.
Edge case: For tenants with on-prem SCIM proxies, reconciler must fallback to delta-only reports and mark action_required=true in report for manual remediation.
